meta.title: Daniel Heinze — PHP & Laravel developer
meta.description: Daniel Heinze, PHP and Laravel developer from Poland. Software engineer at CloudLinux, working on Imunify Connect, and creator of OnSide.

hero.title: I build software that businesses
hero.lead: Hi, I'm Daniel. At CloudLinux I work on Imunify Connect, a malware scanning API for WordPress and PHP plugins. After hours I build OnSide, my own platform for EA FC Pro Clubs.
hero.terminalLabel: Terminal: Daniel Heinze, PHP & Laravel developer. Works on Imunify Connect at CloudLinux and on OnSide.

onside.title: OnSide
onside.text: Everything for EA FC Pro Clubs in one place: self-service sign-up, teams, auto-generated fixtures, results verified through the EA API, public leagues, stats, rankings and achievements.

imunify.title: Imunify Connect
imunify.text: An API and PHP library that lets WordPress and PHP security plugins add Imunify's malware detection and cleanup under their own brand. Scans files by hash and, since the latest release, the WordPress database too.

partio.title: Partio
partio.text: Fast product import and search over a database of millions of records, with file uploads for the team.

grupapwc.title: Grupa PWC
grupapwc.text: One panel for staff and machinery: worked hours, meetings and holidays.

scanbot.title: Scanbot for Filament
scanbot.text: A custom Filament component that brings Scanbot SDK document scanning into an admin panel.

fivio.title: Fivio
fivio.text: Tells suppliers what products are in demand and runs an auction for the best offer.

menago.title: Menago League

about.title: About
body: Five years of PHP, most of them in web hosting. First WHMCS modules at ModulesGarden, now security products at CloudLinux, the company behind CloudLinux OS and Imunify360.
Next to that I build Laravel apps for clients and my own platform, OnSide. I like simple, reliable code and admin panels that are fast to work with.

cloudlinux.text: Imunify Connect: malware scanning API and PHP library for WordPress and PHP plugin developers.
